card: Fixes compact block relay during assumeutxo background validation by ignoring historical blocks in flight when deciding how to request new blocks at the tip. Currently, background sync inflates mapBlocksInFlight, causing the node to fall back to requesting full blocks for new tip blocks. The author notes that compact block relay operates normally once historical blocks are excluded from this check.
evidence: PR description: 'The condition that decides whether a new block is requested as a compact block counted those blocks as well, so with historical blocks in flight the new block at the tip was requested as a full block instead. Do not count blocks that are only needed by the historical chainstate. Compact block relay then works normally during background validation.'
problem: After loading an assumeutxo snapshot, background validation downloads historical blocks, which populate mapBlocksInFlight. Because the compact block decision logic counts all in-flight blocks without distinguishing chainstates, having historical blocks in flight causes the node to request newly announced tip blocks as full blocks rather than compact blocks, wasting bandwidth and slowing tip propagation.

risk.why: A bug in block download or in-flight tracking logic could stall block sync or cause incorrect block requests across peers.

scope_notes: The diff was not provided in the prompt metadata, but commit details indicate a small implementation change paired with an automated test.
summary: Excludes historical blocks needed only by the background chainstate from the blocks-in-flight count when deciding whether to request new tip blocks via compact blocks. This allows nodes running background validation after an assumeutxo snapshot to continue using compact block relay for new blocks at the chain tip. It also includes functional test coverage for requesting compact blocks while historical blocks are in flight.
